_meta.description: Per-client config for the Author Scorecard skill. Keys are filesystem slugs from clients/<slug>/. Database IDs are Notion DBs. The skill fetches data sources at runtime and detects schema. The schema_hints below tell it which property names to try, in order.
_meta.field_resolution: The skill picks the first property name from each *_field_candidates list that exists on the data source schema.
